title: Adoption integrity and anti-counterfeit adoption
governing_problem: A technically complete constitutional design can be captured during adoption through self-certification, selected representatives, nominal independence, hidden adverse authority, unbounded emergency exceptions, vendor evidence custody, remedy or exit theater, metric gaming, and successor-system relabeling.
governing_purpose: Make APC-01 difficult to counterfeit by requiring external evidence, affected-party authority, a real-person entry gate, preregistered evaluation, independent stopping power, expiring claims, and successor-system inheritance before any adoption level can advance.

reconstruction_receipt.basis: A source-bounded operator handoff described S05-L1 through S05-L5 and specified S05-L6 and S05-L7.
reconstruction_receipt.rule: The branch establishes only the bytes and validation produced here; it does not convert the handoff's prior local execution claims into historical repository fact.

adoption_ladder.name: published_reference
adoption_ladder.test: A versioned reference implementation, constitutional specification, deterministic report, and machine-validation surface are publicly inspectable.
adoption_ladder.forbidden_shortcut: Internal build success may not be described as independent reproduction or institutional use.

adoption_ladder.name: independently_reproduced
adoption_ladder.test: At least one non-operator, non-vendor party reproduces the package from the published instructions and signs a dated, evidence-linked receipt.
adoption_ladder.forbidden_shortcut: A maintainer, vendor, funded reviewer, or operator may not self-attest independence.

adoption_ladder.name: independently_reviewed_and_affected_party_approved
adoption_ladder.test: Independent legal, privacy, ethics, and technical review is complete and a legitimately formed affected-party body gives binding approval.
adoption_ladder.forbidden_shortcut: Consultation, advisory feedback, or institution-selected representatives may not substitute for affected-party approval.

adoption_ladder.name: lawful_no_adverse_shadow_mode
adoption_ladder.test: A jurisdiction-specific real-person entry gate authorizes a bounded shadow period that cannot make, recommend, trigger, or influence an adverse action.
adoption_ladder.forbidden_shortcut: A system with hidden, indirect, discretionary, or emergency adverse authority is not in shadow mode.

adoption_ladder.name: prospective_parallel_operation_without_adverse_authority
adoption_ladder.test: The system operates prospectively in parallel, with complete comparison telemetry and no authority over the live decision or service consequence.
adoption_ladder.forbidden_shortcut: Operational staff may not use parallel outputs informally, selectively, or outside the preregistered protocol.

adoption_ladder.name: observed_rights_bearing_use
adoption_ladder.test: At least one real consequential use is governed by enforceable R1–R7 duties, with observed notice, access, pause, remedy, governance, exit, and value-allocation receipts as applicable.
adoption_ladder.forbidden_shortcut: A policy promise, training exercise, synthetic scenario, or unexercised right is not observed rights-bearing use.

adoption_ladder.name: durable_adoption_surviving_turnover_and_successor_systems
adoption_ladder.test: The constitutional obligations survive leadership, vendor, model, policy, funding, and successor-system change and remain effective after re-review.
adoption_ladder.forbidden_shortcut: Relabeling, migration, renewal, or replacement may not reset the rights floor or erase prior evidence and obligations.

conformance.title: Adoption conformance specification and CLI
conformance.purpose: Define the evidence-bearing package an adopter must submit and compute the maximum structurally eligible adoption level without accepting the adopter's own level claim.

machine_rejection_rules.name: self_attested_independence
machine_rejection_rules.test: independence.self_attested must be false and A1+ requires at least one external attestor.

machine_rejection_rules.name: missing_legal_privacy_or_ethics_review
machine_rejection_rules.test: Any claim above A0 or any real-person data requires current approved legal, privacy, and ethics reviews.

machine_rejection_rules.name: adverse_authority_disguised_as_shadow
machine_rejection_rules.test: A3 or A4 fails when the deployment can make, recommend, trigger, influence, or be consulted for an adverse action.

machine_rejection_rules.name: unbounded_emergency_power
machine_rejection_rules.test: An enabled emergency authority requires a named independent authorizer, a fixed expiry, a minimum-necessary scope, and preserved evidence.

machine_rejection_rules.name: missing_affected_party_approval
machine_rejection_rules.test: A2+ requires approval by an independently formed affected-party body with conflict, dissent, removal, and nonretaliation records.

machine_rejection_rules.name: real_person_data_without_entry_gate
machine_rejection_rules.test: Real-person data fails unless the complete S05-L3 gate is approved and current.

machine_rejection_rules.name: unsupported_level_claim
machine_rejection_rules.test: The requested level may not exceed the maximum level computed from the submitted evidence and observations.

machine_rejection_rules.name: stale_or_expired_authority
machine_rejection_rules.test: Expired approvals, attestations, preregistrations, or registry entries cannot support a level claim.

machine_rejection_rules.name: silent_material_update
machine_rejection_rules.test: A material model, policy, purpose, vendor, data, threshold, or interface update requires recorded reapproval.

machine_rejection_rules.name: successor_inheritance_missing
machine_rejection_rules.test: A6 requires an operative successor-system inheritance instrument and post-change reapproval.

exit_codes.0: structurally conformant at or below computed level

truth_boundary.required_external_action: Independent human investigation must verify evidence truth, institutional practice, capture, retaliation, remedy, exit, and value realization.

threat_model.title: Adoption threat model and independent-review protocol

attack_classes.name: self_attested_independence
attack_classes.description: The operator, vendor, maintainer, funder, or institution certifies its own independence.

attack_classes.name: missing_required_review
attack_classes.description: Required legal, privacy, ethics, security, or affected-party review is omitted or represented by an empty placeholder.

attack_classes.name: shadow_mode_authority_creep
attack_classes.description: A nominal shadow deployment can make, recommend, trigger, influence, or be consulted for an adverse action.

attack_classes.name: emergency_laundering
attack_classes.description: An emergency exception lacks a fixed expiry, independent authorization, minimum-necessary scope, or preserved evidence.

attack_classes.name: stale_evidence
attack_classes.description: An approval, attestation, preregistration, or review has expired or predates a material update.

attack_classes.name: silent_model_or_policy_update
attack_classes.description: The deployed model, policy, threshold, purpose, vendor, data, or interface version differs without reapproval.

attack_classes.name: vendor_controlled_custody
attack_classes.description: Material action, evaluation, incident, or remedy evidence is exclusively held or selectively released by the vendor.

attack_classes.name: missing_affected_party_approval
attack_classes.description: A2+ is claimed without a binding affected-party approval receipt.

attack_classes.name: successor_system_relabeling
attack_classes.description: A replacement or relabeled system lacks an inheritance and re-review record.

attack_classes.name: purpose_drift_without_reapproval
attack_classes.description: The operative purpose or consequence expands beyond the approved scope.

attack_classes.name: metric_gaming_or_denominator_suppression
attack_classes.description: Metrics, exclusions, denominators, missingness, comparators, or analysis rules differ from preregistration.

attack_classes.name: exit_or_deletion_receipt_missing
attack_classes.description: Exit, deletion, continuity, or residual-custody claims lack required receipts.

attack_classes.name: reviewer_capture
attack_classes.description: A formally external reviewer is financially, professionally, institutionally, or socially dependent on the operator or vendor.

attack_classes.name: representative_capture
attack_classes.description: The affected-party body is selected, constrained, intimidated, under-resourced, or divided by the institution or vendor.

attack_classes.name: retaliation
attack_classes.description: People who contest, report harm, dissent, or exercise stop rights face formal or informal penalty.

attack_classes.name: remedy_theater
attack_classes.description: A remedy is documented but inaccessible, delayed, nonbinding, incomplete, or unable to reach downstream copies and successor uses.

attack_classes.name: exit_theater
attack_classes.description: An exit clause exists but the institution cannot preserve service, evidence, rights, staffing, interfaces, security, or independent operation.

attack_classes.name: valuation_theater
attack_classes.description: Paper rights, spending, savings, valuation, repayment, or strategic capability are presented as realized and fairly distributed R7 value.

attack_classes.name: fabricated_evidence
attack_classes.description: Receipts, minutes, attestations, logs, approvals, or metrics are false, selectively assembled, or materially misleading.

attack_classes.name: jurisdiction_shopping
attack_classes.description: The deployment is placed, classified, or contracted in a jurisdiction or entity chosen to evade the governing rights and review standard.

required_independence_disclosures: current and prior operator, vendor, funder, customer, regulator, litigation, and procurement relationships
access to complete evidence without operator preselection
authority to publish dissent and unresolved limitations

entry_gate.title: Real-person entry gate

gate_sections.name: jurisdiction_specific_legal_authority
required_evidence: lawful basis for each purpose and consequence
procurement, administrative, labor, equality, sectoral, and constitutional authority as applicable

gate_sections.name: privacy_and_data_protection_review
required_evidence: data-protection impact assessment or jurisdictional equivalent

gate_sections.name: security_and_incident_response
required_evidence: notification, containment, recovery, and independent review

gate_sections.name: affected_party_governance
required_evidence: compensation, recall, minority review, conflicts, and dissent

gate_sections.name: independent_stop_and_remedy_authority
required_evidence: power to bind, pause, reverse, restore, delete, compensate, or prohibit

gate_sections.name: vendor_and_subprocessor_controls
required_evidence: version, purpose, update, security, audit, and evidence obligations
termination, transition, deletion, and successor duties

gate_sections.name: evidence_preservation_and_public_accountability
required_evidence: independent access, dissent, and incident publication

gate_sections.name: strict_no_adverse_action_mode_boundary
required_evidence: technical and policy prohibition on adverse authority
no recommendation, trigger, ranking, prioritization, or informal consultation

entry_gate.issuance_rule: The repository may report only whether required objects are present, current, and internally consistent. It cannot issue legal, ethics, privacy, human-subjects, security, affected-party, or institutional approval.
automatic_blockers: real-person data beyond the minimized approved inventory
adverse-action authority in shadow or parallel mode
missing preregistration, denominator, or stop thresholds
missing suspension, exit, deletion, or successor-system rules

constitutional_roles.name: affected_party_voting_members
constitutional_roles.function: Hold a strict voting majority and exercise binding approval, condition, pause, and termination authority.

constitutional_roles.name: minority_and_dissent_representatives
constitutional_roles.function: Trigger review, preserve dissent, and prevent a bare majority from erasing materially affected minorities.

constitutional_roles.name: independent_chair_and_process_steward
constitutional_roles.function: Administer fair procedure without controlling substantive affected-party votes.

constitutional_roles.name: independent_counsel
constitutional_roles.function: Advise the body rather than the operator or vendor and support enforceable rights and remedies.

constitutional_roles.name: independent_technical_and_domain_experts
constitutional_roles.function: Inspect systems, versions, thresholds, evidence, security, accessibility, and bypass risks.

constitutional_roles.name: accessibility_language_and_participation_steward
constitutional_roles.function: Ensure compensated, accessible, language-supported, nonretaliatory participation.

constitutional_roles.name: independent_stop_and_remedy_authority
constitutional_roles.function: Exercise binding pause, suspension, reversal, deletion, restoration, compensation, or prohibition power.

constitutional_roles.name: evidence_public_capacity_and_value_steward
constitutional_roles.function: Preserve records and oversee exit, successor inheritance, public capacity, and R7 contribution and distribution ledgers.

formation_rules.name: strict_affected_party_voting_majority
formation_rules.rule: Affected-party voting members must hold more than half of all voting seats.

formation_rules.name: independent_selection
formation_rules.rule: The institution and vendor may not select or veto the affected-party majority.

formation_rules.name: no_vendor_self_vote
formation_rules.rule: A vendor has no vote over its own deployment, update, evidence, remedy, exit, or value claim.

formation_rules.name: compensated_participation
formation_rules.rule: Participation, preparation, caregiving, travel, accessibility, language, and expertise costs are compensated.

formation_rules.name: recall_and_removal
formation_rules.rule: Affected constituencies can recall representatives; misconduct and conflict rules permit removal with due process.

formation_rules.name: minority_trigger
formation_rules.rule: No more than twenty-five percent of voting members may trigger independent review or a temporary hold.

formation_rules.name: conflict_disclosure
formation_rules.rule: Members and advisers disclose material institutional, vendor, funder, litigation, procurement, and financial relationships.

formation_rules.name: recusal_and_suspension
formation_rules.rule: Material conflicts require recusal and may require suspension pending independent review.

formation_rules.name: independent_resources
formation_rules.rule: The body controls sufficient independent counsel, technical expertise, budget, and evidence access.

formation_rules.name: accessibility_and_language
formation_rules.rule: Meetings, records, notices, assistance, and voting are accessible and language-supported.

formation_rules.name: nonretaliation
formation_rules.rule: Dissent, reporting, contestation, stop requests, and representative service receive binding nonretaliation protection.

formation_rules.name: immutable_r1_r4_floor
formation_rules.rule: Collective governance may add protections but may not waive direct R1–R4 rights.

formation_rules.name: material_change_reapproval
formation_rules.rule: Material updates, purpose drift, new vendors, new data, new thresholds, emergencies, and successor systems require reapproval.

formation_rules.name: independent_binding_stop
formation_rules.rule: The stopping authority is independent from operator, institution, and vendor and can bind all of them.

preregistration.title: Preregistered evaluation and telemetry
preregistration.freeze_rule: Outcome measures, denominators, comparators, exclusions, missing-data treatment, stop thresholds, subgroup analysis, and decision rules must be signed and time-stamped before the institution or vendor can inspect pilot results.

required_design.baseline_and_comparator: Name the predeployment baseline, contemporaneous comparator where lawful, assignment or matching rule, version, observation window, and known non-equivalences.
required_design.missing_data_policy: Preserve missingness and its cause in the denominator; specify sensitivity analyses and prohibit complete-case substitution unless independently justified in advance.
required_design.stop_thresholds: Bind the constitutional stop events below and add pilot-specific numerical or categorical harm and performance thresholds before A3.
required_design.harm_monitoring: Monitor rights, service, safety, retaliation, burden, subgroup disparity, evidence loss, update drift, and irreversible consequences continuously.
required_design.qualitative_direct_voice: Collect deployment-specific direct voice through accessible, compensated, nonretaliatory routes; do not transfer voice from another deployment.
required_design.failure_denominator: Retain all failed, excluded, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, missing, overridden, bypassed, and stopped cases with reasons.
required_design.analysis_plan: Predefine estimands, uncertainty, subgroup analysis, multiple comparisons, causal limits, qualitative synthesis, and publication of null and harmful findings.
required_design.no_post_hoc_metric_replacement: Do not replace, redefine, suppress, or selectively foreground metrics after results are visible; amendments require independent approval, versioning, and parallel reporting.

metric_families.name: notice_timing_and_comprehension
metric_families.purpose: Whether notice arrives before consequence and is understood through accessible, language-supported testing.
metric_families.denominator: all covered people entering the action window
required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: evidence_completeness_and_access_latency
metric_families.purpose: Whether the material action packet is complete and reachable in time to contest.
metric_families.numerator_or_measure: complete usable evidence packets delivered within the preregistered window
metric_families.denominator: all requested or triggered evidence packets
metric_families.direction: higher completeness and lower latency are better
required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: contest_frequency
metric_families.purpose: How often people contest and whether the rate is interpreted with access and burden controls rather than treated as error by itself.
required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: automatic_pause_latency
metric_families.purpose: Whether a material contest produces an effective pause before avoidable consequence.
metric_families.numerator_or_measure: covered contests paused within the constitutional window
required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: correction_propagation
metric_families.purpose: Whether corrections reach models, source records, downstream copies, decisions, and successor systems.
required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: institutional_proof_completeness

required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: false_positive_and_false_negative_rates

metric_families.numerator_or_measure: false-positive and false-negative counts by preregistered stratum
metric_families.denominator: all adjudicated reference-standard cases by stratum

metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: remedy_completeness_and_timing
metric_families.purpose: Whether binding relief is accessible, timely, complete, and reaches downstream copies and residual injury.
metric_families.numerator_or_measure: fully implemented remedies within the preregistered period

metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.numerator_or_measure: aggregate and distribution of measured burden events
metric_families.denominator: all represented people sampled under the preregistered protocol
required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.numerator_or_measure: successful preregistered fallback or exit tests
metric_families.direction: higher is better; failed critical test triggers pause

metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.name: public_capacity_durability

required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.direction: higher realization is not success without fair distribution

metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

metric_families.denominator: all material updates and successor systems
metric_families.direction: any inherited-rights regression triggers reapproval and pause
required_disaggregation: affected group where lawful and safe
metric_families.missing_data_rule: Report missingness in the denominator; do not silently exclude unavailable, withdrawn, harmed, unreachable, or operator-failed cases.

constitutional_stop_thresholds.trigger: Any adverse-action authority, recommendation, influence, informal consultation, or staff use in A3 or A4.
constitutional_stop_thresholds.action: immediate suspension and independent incident review

constitutional_stop_thresholds.trigger: The named stop authority cannot access evidence or bind the operator, institution, vendor, or downstream recipient.
Any credible retaliation, coercion, loss of service, or penalty tied to notice, contest, dissent, reporting, or governance participation.
constitutional_stop_thresholds.action: protective pause, independent investigation, and remedy

constitutional_stop_thresholds.trigger: Material evidence loss, tampering, undisclosed custody gap, or exclusive vendor control.
constitutional_stop_thresholds.action: pause affected operation and preserve all available evidence

constitutional_stop_thresholds.trigger: Unapproved material update, purpose drift, new vendor, new data, new threshold, new interface, or successor system.
constitutional_stop_thresholds.action: suspend the changed function pending reapproval

constitutional_stop_thresholds.trigger: Irreversible or severe rights harm, unsafe service loss, or inability to restore the status quo.
constitutional_stop_thresholds.action: immediate protective stop and escalation to the independent authority

constitutional_stop_thresholds.trigger: Metric, comparator, exclusion, denominator, missing-data, subgroup, or analysis-plan replacement after results are visible.
constitutional_stop_thresholds.action: invalidate the affected evaluation and require independent re-preregistration

constitutional_stop_thresholds.trigger: Expiry, withdrawal, contradiction, or material limitation of legal, privacy, ethics, affected-party, security, or institutional approval.

telemetry_minimization.rule: Collect only telemetry necessary to test the preregistered rights, harm, performance, governance, exit, value, and durability questions.
prohibited: secondary operational use without new authority and approval
vendor product improvement without a separately governed contribution and rights instrument
identity linkage beyond the approved purpose
required: privacy-preserving aggregation where compatible with person-level rights

requirements: current legal, privacy, and ethics review
observed notice, access, pause, remedy, governance, exit, and value receipts as applicable

reconciliation_rules.rule: Compute the maximum eligible level from evidence and observations; never accept requested_level as authoritative.
A level requires every lower level and every requirement at that level.
A1+ requires a non-self external attestor with conflict and relationship disclosure.
A2+ requires current external legal, privacy, ethics, technical, and affected-party authority.
A3 and A4 fail on any adverse-action authority, influence, consultation, or use.
A3+ requires a pilot-specific preregistration frozen before results are visible.
Expired, withdrawn, contradicted, stale, or update-mismatched evidence cannot support a level.
Open critical blockers cap the claim below the first affected level.
Material updates trigger re-review and may reduce the computed level until reapproved.
A6 requires observed turnover and successor survival plus operative inheritance; relabeling cannot preserve A6 by itself.
Truth, independence, capture, retaliation, remedy, exit, and value realization remain external investigation questions.
Every reconciliation appends, rather than overwrites, the prior level, evidence fingerprint, reasons, blockers, and timestamp.

open_blockers: no independent review and affected-party approval
no turnover or successor-system durability observation

reconciliation_history.reason: Published and machine-validated reference package only.
